scope: Indianapolis operation of the multi-location Fire Dawgs brand; an older local article and the current Indianapolis page were reviewed.

metrics.label: Reuse, donation or recycling commitment
metrics.context: Company claim/commitment for removed items; no independent waste-diversion measurement reviewed.

observations.title: Send review-seeking visitors to actual reviews
observations.observed: On the older Indianapolis article, Google Reviews links to a legacy Google+ URL; following it opened Google's 2023 Currents update rather than this business's reviews.
observations.improvement: Replace that one link with a verified current review profile. Check other legacy local pages for the same destination, then test on desktop and a phone.

observations.title: Bring legacy Indianapolis visitors into the current enquiry flow
observations.observed: The older article focuses on the company story and phone/email contact. The current Indianapolis page also explains text-photo estimates, booking and service questions. Both remain accessible.
observations.improvement: Add a local quote or photo-estimate path to the older article. Review traffic and inbound links before consolidation; use the same local campaign destination.

limitations: The review-link issue concerns one observed link destination on the older article. The current Indianapolis service page was also accessible.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
